bullets.text: Apple TV Supports Google Cast - **Apple** enhances its streaming service for Android users amidst **Netflix**'s withdrawal from the feature.
UK Government's Age Verification Push - **Apple** and **Google** may need to block nude photos without age verification.
iOS 26.2 Enhances AirPods Features - New **AirPods** Live Translation expands to EU users, improving accessibility.
Tesla's Marketing Under Fire - A judge rules **Tesla** engaged in deceptive marketing regarding its Autopilot features.
Netflix Expands Video Podcasts - **Netflix** partners with **iHeartMedia** to launch 14 exclusive video podcasts in 2026.
Meta's AI Glasses Update - **Meta** enhances its smart glasses to amplify conversations in noisy environments.
DoorDash Launches Zesty App - **DoorDash** introduces an AI-driven app for discovering local restaurants.
Whole Foods to Install Smart Bins - **Whole Foods** partners with **Mill** to deploy smart food waste bins starting in 2027.
